BiblicalUsage: Atroth-addar was a town on the border of Ephraim, named twice as the boundary line was drawn from the Jordan up to the hill country. It marked where one tribe's land ended and another's began.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a boundary town matters because the land was God's gift measured out tribe by tribe, and every border in the record was drawn by His hand.
